subject.title: feat: clarify publisher discovery state labels

question: Should this PR establish the `Official publisher`, `Public profile`, and `Public catalog` vocabulary now, or should that vocabulary wait for the adjacent feed, publisher-state, and follow-discovery drafts?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but the added spec records durable product semantics that CI and automated review cannot approve on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Accept After Proof
options.body: Add real browser proof for the changed labels, then merge this narrow vocabulary slice as the current profile/discovery direction.

options.title: Consolidate With Adjacent Drafts
options.body: Hold this PR until the related feed, state, and follow drafts define one shared vocabulary.

options.title: Narrow To UI Copy Only
options.body: Remove or defer the forward-looking spec and keep only the code-backed label clarification.

recommendation.title: Accept After Proof
recommendation.body: Add real browser proof for the changed labels, then merge this narrow vocabulary slice as the current profile/discovery direction.
